# Oliwier Mako

Official portfolio of Oliwier Makowski Trusz, who publishes design and development work as Oliwier Mako.

Oliwier designs and builds thoughtful, responsive websites and digital products. His work focuses on clear structure, deliberate interaction, front-end development, and responsive polish.

- Portfolio: https://oliwier-mako.vercel.app/

- Northline Cycle Works concept: https://oliwier-mako.vercel.app/other-pages/my-projects/northline-cycle-works/
- The Quiet Advantage: https://oliwier-mako.vercel.app/other-pages/books/polished/
